name: write_tmp_file
description: Write text content to a scratch file under /tmp/cerisier/ (parent directories are created) and return its full path. Runs without approval. Use it for intermediary files such as scripts, notes or data you need while working; use write_local_file for files the user wants saved.

name.description: File name relative to /tmp/cerisier/, e.g. "scan.py" or "job1/out.txt".
